ValidationRule.description: Restrict Systemic Issue user from editing the shared fields between complaint and systemic issue.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Systemic_Issue_Team', OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint', ISCHANGED( RecordTypeId ) ), OR( ISCHANGED( Status ), ISCHANGED( Origin ), ISCHANGED( Subject ), ISCHANGED( Description ), ISCHANGED( IDR_Description_of_Outcome__c ), ISCHANGED( OwnerId ), ISCHANGED( RecordTypeId ), ISCHANGED( IDR_AFCA_Number__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not authorised to make update to this field. You can update only Parent Systemic Issue field in a complaint record.
